title: Taraxacum officinale tea for medicinal use
intro: Taraxacum officinale tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and flowers of the dandelion plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its detoxifying and digestive benefits. This tea is known to support liver function and aid in the removal of toxins from the body. It is also used to promote healthy digestion and alleviate symptoms of indigestion. Dandelion tea is often consumed as a natural diuretic and may help in maintaining kidney health.
